race.title: Gary Wrights Big 40th Birthday Celebration Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: It may pay to concentrate on SO YOU KNOW and Paso Doble , who both made winning reappearances last season. The former gets the nod on just his second start over a trip that really should suit. He's A Latchico could be a danger, if the market expects him to leave behind a lacklustre comeback run. SO YOU KNOW (IRE) PASO DOBLE (IRE) HE'S A LATCHICO (IRE)
